scope: independent LRS opt-in native-evaluation implementation; no change of solver/model
question: Can borrowing the identical ordered node sequence remove per-cached-RHS PreparedAbsorption photon-state/node clones while preserving finite native outcomes and providing measurable cost improvement?
allowed_paths: src/bin/lrs_batch.rs (only CLI mode forwarding if needed)
forbidden_changes: all original 152 native baseline file bytes (the already existing exact parent append remains)
FD epsilon, perturbation policy, solver tolerances, charge/admissibility order, fatal propagation, commit semantics
implementation: Add opt-in NativeEval::CellBorrowed / --native-eval cell-borrowed; preserve legacy and existing cell-cache as references.
Extract original addon native_rates body once into a shared borrowed iterator helper. Both PreparedAbsorption and borrowed view call this body; do not duplicate or re-express physical arithmetic.

Borrowed view holds state/cache references and at most one owned replacement PreparedCell, prepared by original prepare_cell. Preserve stale/support/shape/index checks, diagnostics folds and original increasing cell then within-cell node order. Empty cells yield no nodes.
No inner threading/SIMD/reassociated reductions, unsafe code, new dependencies or physical approximations.

Track narrowly named cached_prepared_state_clones and cached_prepared_node_clones if useful, excluding the once-per-Jacobian base clone and coordinate decoding. These are explicit operation counters, not allocation bytes, peak RSS or bandwidth measurements.

acceptance.correctness: Existing legacy/cache regression tests continue to pass; extend meaningful native equality coverage to borrowed mode, including seeded/empty/delta Jacobians, changed threshold/steep cells and stale support/shape/index failure; resource cap transactional and domain/fatal classifications are unchanged. Require exact finite numerical equality and structure equality for shared physical fields on tested fixtures; do not claim signed-zero bit equality or a universal solver theorem.
acceptance.native_replay: Replay existing 19-case settings once with cell-borrowed and compare raw non-time physical fields to previously admitted same cell-cache settings; classify this as replay of existing fixtures, not new 19 scientific models/histories. Run limited new legacy/cache controls when needed to establish shared-kernel baseline continuity.
acceptance.cost: For same-binary cell-cache vs cell-borrowed, CPU0, profiling OFF, warmups then 5 paired AB/BA repetitions per fixed/birth/disabled Radau N16. Preserve each raw output/stdout/stderr/exit/binary identity. Report median paired speed ratios and dispersion, scoped to environment. No speedup claim unless observed; no memory-reduction claim from clone counts alone.
acceptance.stopping_rule: One bounded targeted repair for a concrete implementation/test failure after Astra classification. Stop optional testing when changed-path risks and finite claims are resolved. Return to Astra for acceptance/model ambiguity.

execution.implementer: existing lower-tier opt20_coder; requested versus observed model identity recorded separately
execution.reviewer: Astra-tier opt20_intake_theory did not implement this change
